frequency_question: Among comparable highly contested major fee regulations proposed by federal agencies, what proportion are successfully finalized within approximately one year?
membership_rule: Includes any notice of proposed rulemaking (NPRM) by a federal agency involving significant structural or fee changes that attract substantial public opposition and litigation threats, evaluated for final rule publication within 365 days of proposal. Excludes routine updates and non-contested procedural adjustments.

skeleton: 7 named cases across recent administrations representing highly contested major rules with fee or structural mandates.
multiplier: 7 / 7 evaluated within timeline constraints where executive priority is high.
validity_reason: Base rate tied to standard federal rulemaking administrative procedures under the APA, valid until structural administrative law changes occur.
